title: vandellia brevipedunculata
intro: Vandellia brevipedunculata, commonly known as 'Dhundhal', is a medicinal plant native to tropical regions. It is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Vandellia brevipedunculata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
